SELECT kd.detail_id AS trace_id, wo.work_order_id, wo.work_order_no AS batch_out, wo.product_code, wo.product_name, COALESCE(rm.return_no, CONCAT('领料-', kd.material_code)) AS batch_in, kd.material_id AS material_in, kd.material_code, kd.material_name, kd.spec_model, kd.unit, kd.required_qty AS qty_used FROM mms_kit_check_detail kd INNER JOIN mms_kit_check kc ON kc.kit_id = kd.kit_id AND kc.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN mms_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = kc.work_order_id AND wo.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN mms_return_material rm ON rm.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id AND rm.material_id = kd.material_id AND rm.del_flag = '0'
kd.del_flag = '0' AND wo.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND wo.work_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchOut}, '%') AND COALESCE(rm.return_no, CONCAT('领料-', kd.material_code)) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchIn}, '%') AND kd.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
ORDER BY wo.work_order_id DESC, kd.detail_id

SELECT kd.detail_id AS trace_id, wo.work_order_id, wo.work_order_no AS batch_out, wo.product_code, wo.product_name, COALESCE(rm.return_no, CONCAT('领料-', kd.material_code)) AS batch_in, kd.material_id AS material_in, kd.material_code, kd.material_name, kd.spec_model, kd.unit, kd.required_qty AS qty_used FROM mms_kit_check_detail kd INNER JOIN mms_kit_check kc ON kc.kit_id = kd.kit_id AND kc.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN mms_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = kc.work_order_id AND wo.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN mms_return_material rm ON rm.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id AND rm.material_id = kd.material_id AND rm.del_flag = '0' WHERE kd.del_flag = '0' AND kd.detail_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY wo.work_order_id DESC, kd.detail_id
